name: ecuador-mcp
description: Ecuador's open government data for AI assistants: CKAN, SRI, BCE, INEC, Supercias, SERCOP and more.
long_description: Search and analyze Ecuador's official open data through MCP: the national and municipal CKAN portals, gob.ec procedures and regulations, SRI, BCE, INEC/ANDA, Supercías, Superbancos, SERCOP public procurement, IG-EPN earthquakes, SGR risk events, CENACE, ARCONEL and power-cut schedules, among other sources. Read-only; no credentials needed.
